privacy.seoDescription: Privacy policy for Quiz Couple - Personal data protection and GDPR compliance.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy defines and informs you of how Quiz Couple uses and protects the information you provide to us, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.s2_1Intro: To improve your experience, we use your browser's local storage (LocalStorage) for:
privacy.s2_1Item2: Remembering your theme preferences (light or dark mode)
privacy.s2_1Item3: Keeping results from your previous quizzes
privacy.s2_1ImportantText: This data is stored exclusively on your device and is never transmitted to our servers or to third parties. You can delete it at any time by clearing your browser's browsing data.
privacy.s2_2Intro: For the "Solve a couple problem" feature using artificial intelligence, we temporarily record:
privacy.s2_2Item1Text: Used only to limit usage to one request per day per user
privacy.s2_2ImportantText: This technical data is kept for a maximum of 7 days then automatically deleted. The content of your descriptions and versions of events is never stored on our servers — it is only transmitted to the AI for analysis and then immediately deleted.
privacy.s3Intro: Our "Solve a couple problem" feature uses an artificial intelligence model (OpenAI) to analyze conflicts and offer advice.
privacy.s3_1Item1: Texts you submit are sent to the OpenAI API for analysis
privacy.s3_1Item2: No personally identifiable data is transmitted (no full name, email, etc.)
privacy.s3_1Item3: First names used are the only nominative information transmitted
privacy.s3_1Item4: Data is not used to train AI models
privacy.s3_2Warning: ⚠️ The analysis provided by the AI is for informational purposes only. It does not constitute medical, psychological or professional therapeutic advice. For serious relationship issues, we recommend consulting a qualified professional (couples therapist, psychologist, marriage counselor).
privacy.s4Intro: Quiz Couple uses Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to measure website traffic and improve user experience. This service uses cookies to collect anonymized information about your browsing.
privacy.s4Item1: Google Analytics 4 is subject to Google Consent Mode v2: analytics cookies are only placed after your explicit consent via our cookie banner
privacy.s4Item2: If you decline cookies, no browsing data is collected by Google Analytics
privacy.s4Item3: Collected data is anonymized and cannot be used to personally identify you
privacy.s4Item4: No advertising cookies or social media cookies
privacy.s4Outro: You can change your choice at any time by clearing your browser cookies. For more information on Google's cookie management, see Google's privacy policy.
privacy.s5Intro: We implement the following security measures to protect your browsing:
privacy.s5Item1Text: All communications between your browser and our site are encrypted
privacy.s5Item2Text: Technical data is stored securely with strict access policies
privacy.s5Item3Text: We only collect data strictly necessary for the service to function
privacy.s5Item4Text: We follow best practices in secure web development
privacy.s6Intro: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy.s6Item1Text: Obtain confirmation of whether your data is being processed
privacy.s6Item4Text: Receive your data in a structured format
privacy.s6Item5Text: Object to the processing of your data
privacy.s6Outro: To exercise these rights regarding usage limitation data, contact us at the address below.
privacy.s7Text: Technical data is hosted on secure servers provided by our technical partners. Communications with the AI pass through servers that comply with current security standards.
privacy.s8Text: Our site may contain links to external sites. We invite you to consult the privacy policies of these sites, as we are not responsible for their data protection practices.
privacy.s9Text: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an update date. We encourage you to check this page regularly.
privacy.s10Text: For any questions about this privacy policy or to exercise your rights, you can contact us at the following address:
